title: aquilegia formosa var. caelifax
intro: Aquilegia formosa var. caelifax, commonly known as the golden alpine columbine, is a flowering plant species within the Aquilegia genus. This plant is known for its vibrant, bell-shaped flowers, which are typically yellow in color with a slight red or pink tint. Research on Aquilegia formosa var. caelifax suggests that it may possess health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which could be attributed to its therapeutic actions of soothing and calming the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
